setupPage.theRegisterIsKeptBy: The register is kept by people. Other products can open a risk too, so a finding nobody fixes becomes a decision somebody makes.
setupPage.openARiskFromAnother: Open a risk from another product
setupPage.withAnApiTokenWith: With an API token with the editor role. The same source and reference open one risk, so sending it again changes nothing.
setupPage.theScoreIsLikelihoodTimes: The score is likelihood times impact, each 1 to 5: low under 5, medium from 5, high from 10, critical from 17.
setupPage.acceptingARiskNeedsA: Accepting a risk needs a reason, an approver and an end within a year. When it ends, the risk is due for review again.
setupPage.risksAndVendorsHaveA: Risks and vendors have a review interval; overdue reviews show on the register and in /metrics.
setupPage.everyChangeIsKeptIn: Every change is kept in the history with who made it, and nobody edits the history.

settingsPage.askAnAdminOfThis: Ask an admin of this risk for access.
